observations: Black DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' branding and 'D3400' model badge visible on the front.
Telephoto lens attached with 'Nikon DX AF-P NIKKOR 70-300mm 1:4.5-6.3G ED' markings on the barrel.
The rubber grip on the right side of the camera body shows significant wear, peeling, and surface degradation.
The camera is resting on a white box with 'McSteve Gadget Store' printed on it.
All photos contain a 'POSTED ON JIJI MCSTEVE' watermark.
The camera is not shown powered on, and the rear LCD screen is not visible in any shot.

claims.evidence: No photos show the camera powered on or displaying an image.
photo 2 shows significant cosmetic damage and peeling on the rubber grip.
photo 0 and photo 1 clearly show Nikon branding.

risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, autofocusing, and capturing/reviewing a photo.
Clear, close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements and the camera sensor.
A screenshot from a shutter count tool using a recent RAW or JPEG file from the camera.
A photo of the camera next to a handwritten note with the seller's name and today's date.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo of the camera with a handwritten note showing your name and today's date.
Close-up photos of the lens glass (front and back) and the sensor.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Nikon D3400 with a 70-300mm lens. The seller's claims of 'no fault' and 'Canon' brand are contradicted by visible grip damage and Nikon branding. It is priced at the worst case for functionality and condition.
